These tiny fixtures were authored for Commonplace's tests and contain no third-party book text. `indexes.pdf` has two text pages. `indexes.epub` has two spine sections, metadata, an entity, Unicode text, and script/style content that must not be extracted. `image-only.pdf` is an empty-text page representing a document needing OCR. `unsafe.epub` contains a deliberately invalid archive path. They may be redistributed with this project.
